question: The conversion of 0.0 overline{37} in the form (p)/(q) is:
solution:
**Calculation:**

Let x = 0.037...(1)

Multiplying by 10 in equation (1)

⇒ 10x = 0.37 ...(2)

Multiplying by 100 in equation (2)

⇒ 1000x = 37...(3)

Subtracting equation (2) from (3)

⇒ (1000x – 10x) = (37.37 – 0.37)

⇒ 990x = 37

⇒ x = 37/990

**∴ The value of p/q is 37/990**
